Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config

Record Class GatewayInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config.GatewayInfo
Record Components:
name - the gateway's name in the config
type - the transport it uses
enabled - false switches it off with all its models
url - the endpoint requests are sent to
apiKeyFile - the file holding the API key; null if none is configured
apiKey - the key read from apiKeyFile; null if there is none, or the file is missing or empty
connectTimeout - the longest wait for a connection
cooldown - how long to hold back after a rate limit that doesn't say how long, or after failing to connect
maxParallel - the provider's cap on requests in flight across the gateway's models; 0 for none
rateLimit - the provider's limits across the gateway's models
public record GatewayInfo(String name, GatewayType type, boolean enabled, String url, File apiKeyFile, String apiKey, Duration connectTimeout, Duration cooldown, int maxParallel, RateLimit rateLimit) extends Record
A gateway as the global config defines it: where models are hosted and what the provider enforces.
